changes: Typing in search no longer lags: a search you have already typed past stops at once instead of scanning on under the next letters, and online titles are looked up only for videos their own name does not answer
A slow start no longer lands on the bring your first video in card while your library is still loading: that card now stands only when Home has truly settled empty
An episode whose name carries a tail after the show's name, like a season END, now joins its series instead of standing as a single file
notes: Search typing is smooth, a slow start waits for your library, and episodes named with a tail join their series.
